## Für Sie in Form - seit 1412
Unser Anspruch ist höchste Qualität: Von der Planung bis zur Bearbeitung garantieren unsere kompetenten Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter, dass Sie das beste Produkt erhalten. Dabei sind wir Ihr zuverlässiger Partner, der Ihre Bedürfnisse versteht und Ihre Anforderungen erfüllt. 
Profitieren Sie von unserer Flexibilität, die es uns ermöglicht, sowohl individuelle Projekte als auch große Produktionsmengen effizient umzusetzen. Durch unsere langjährige Erfahrung und modernste Technologien bieten wir Ihnen maßgeschneiderte Lösungen von der Konzeption bis zur Serienfertigung. Dabei legen wir besonderen Wert auf Nachhaltigkeit, indem wir umweltfreundliche Prozesse implementieren und Ressourcen schonen.

# Products & Services
From concept to product
Every year, Schmiedeberger Gießerei GmbH manufactures around 3,000 different products and launches around 400 new products onto the market, demonstrating our continuous investment in innovation and quality. They are the result of a strong market response and an established reputation in the industry.
We provide over 350 customers worldwide with customised solutions and the ability to produce large quantities at competitive prices. Our experts are available to advise you on material selection, casting design, surface finishing, testing methods and more to help you realise the full potential of casting technology. Thanks to our broad product range, we can respond flexibly to the needs of our customers and serve a wide variety of industries. Discover how we can help you realise your vision and achieve your goals.
![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/06/DSC1438_BaldaufBaldauf.jpg)
### Consulting & Modelling
We offer our customers a comprehensive service and develop an optimised geometry for the production of cast parts, in which the casting technology requirements for stable and quality-assured production processes are integrated.
[Consulting & Modelling](https://schmie-guss.de/products-services/modelling-advice/)
![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/03/Gussherstellung.webp)
### Casting production
Whether filigree or cast parts in large dimensions; whether nodular cast iron, grey cast iron or malleable cast iron - our technical equipment allows us a unique wealth of possibilities in the production of cast parts weighing up to approx. 400.00 kg.
[Casting production](https://schmie-guss.de/products-services/casting-production/)
![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/03/Qualitaetssicherung.webp)
### Quality assurance
Integrated quality assurance at all product stages guarantees consistently high-quality castings. Since 1995, our company has been continuously tested and certified for the manufacture, processing and distribution of cast products.
[Quality assurance](https://schmie-guss.de/products-services/quality-assurance/)
## SG CNC Bearbeitungs GmbH
Finishing and casting refinement
With our subsidiary SG CNC Bearbeitungs GmbH, founded in 2016, we can also carry out cast part machining in-house. In a new production hall built on our premises, we process a growing part of our foundry's casting volume on the 13 CNC turning and milling centres of SG CNC Bearbeitungs GmbH.
Our comprehensive expertise, many years of experience in the CNC machining of cast parts in conjunction with our modern machinery and our extensive network of cooperation partners create the best conditions for the realisation of your requirements - from prototypes and small series from 3 pieces up to large series of approx. 10,000 pieces with an average volume of between 50 and 100 pieces per series. 
[SG CNC Bearbeitungs GmbH](https://schmie-guss.de/products-services/sg-cnc-bearbeitungs-gmbh/)

Sustainability
# Produce sustainably, act locally
In our foundry, we place a strong focus on sustainability and social commitment, because we firmly believe that responsibility for the environment and the community are inextricably linked.
We carefully assess the energy and environmental relevance of our raw materials, operating and auxiliary materials, products, machines and systems before purchasing to ensure that we choose the most environmentally friendly options. We are always on the lookout for innovative solutions to minimise our ecological footprint.

  * ![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/themes/emk_publisher-coswig-child-schmiedeberg/img_system/all/bullet-point-extra.svg)

  * ![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/themes/emk_publisher-coswig-child-schmiedeberg/img_system/all/bullet-point-extra.svg)

  * ![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/themes/emk_publisher-coswig-child-schmiedeberg/img_system/all/bullet-point-extra.svg)

# History
In shape for you for over 600 years 
Schmiedeberger Gießerei GmbH was founded in 1412 and is one of the oldest subsidiaries of the DiHAG Group. Discover our various stages of development from the ‘iron hammer’ to the high-tech company we are today.
2023
![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/08/Dihag-Schmiedeberg-Maus.webp)
Commissioning of the automatic fettling centres ‘Maus 600’ and ‘Maus 900’ from Reichmann 
2019
Capacity expansion of melting furnaces 1 and 2 from 5 tonnes to 6 tonnes
2016
Foundation of ‘SG CNC Bearbeitungs GmbH’ at the foundry site
2014
![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/08/Dihag-Schmiedeberg-Sandaufbereitungsanlage-3.webp)
Construction of the 2nd fully automatic sand preparation system for moulding plant 2
2012
New compressor station with waste heat utilisation and expansion of the core shop (80 l machine)
2008
Commissioning of the 2nd moulding line with box size 1400x900x400/400
1996
![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/04/Ausbildung-212.webp)
Shutdown of the manual moulding shop and commissioning of the automatic green sand SEIATSU moulding plant with box size 900x700x250/200
1996
![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/08/2024-Header-Dihag-Logo.webp)
Takeover into the DIHAG group of companies
1994
Commissioning of the electric melting furnaces
1990
Foundation of Schmiedeberger Gießerei GmbH
1954
Spin-off from VEB Nagema and foundation of the independent company VEB Gießerei und Maschinenbau ‘Ferdinand Kuhnert’ Schmiedeberg
1951
First-time production of foundry machines and systems
1948
![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/03/1921-16_9.webp)
VEB Mühlenbau Schmiedeberg
1946
Transfer of the company to public ownership
1945
Dismantling the systems
1943
Construction of a steel and tempering plant
1925
![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/03/1905-16_9.webp)
Germany's most important milling companies merged to form MIAG - Mühlenbau Industrie Aktiengesellschaft
1889
the factory was officially called ‘Eisenwerk Schmiedeberg’
1885
![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/03/1885-16_9.webp)
‘Eisenhüttenwerk und Maschinenbauanstalt Schmiedeberg’, production of forgeable cast iron
1839
![](https://schmie-guss.de/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2024/03/1412-16_9.webp)
Birth of the Schmiedeberg foundry and construction of a blast furnace
1791
the so-called iron hammer was already producing 2000 - 3000 hundredweights of pig iron a year
1412
First documented mention of a ‘Nuwen Smedewercke’ - a new forge

Mould your ideas into perfection.
Schmiedeberger Gießerei GmbH not only produces high-quality castings, but is also a reliable partner who understands your needs and fulfils your requirements. Thanks to our many years of experience and state-of-the-art technologies, we can offer you customised solutions from conception to series production.
Benefit from our flexibility, which enables us to efficiently realise both individual projects and large production quantities. We are not only available to you as a manufacturer, but also as a consultant who supports you in selecting the right materials, designing your castings and many other steps.
